name: Crawling Form

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

prerequisites: born of animal or born of celestial heritage
text: You can transform into a small animal or celestial creature to scurry and spy. You can Change Shape to assume a crawling form. While in crawling form, you gain the effect of a 1st-rank Pest Form, except you can transform only into a shape matching your heritage; for example, if you were once were a wolf, you turn into a wolf puppy.
